text:
Aisha: heads-up vendor pushed APAC rack handoff to Monday AM, they require a firmware preflight before we can onboard — this collides with tomorrow evening's demo window.
Rory: do they insist on onsite techs or can we do a remote IPMI flash?
Aisha: vendor says onsite preferred but will accept remote if we provide a signed access window, bastion creds, and a 90m maintenance window.
Ben: how many GPUs are affected? need to decide borrow vs shrink test.
Aisha: about 10 A100s out of the apac-demo slice. demo planned 6 concurrent workers.
Sofia: EU-standby can spare 4 during that window but their RDMA tuning may add jitter.
Ben: 4 short. Options: 1) reduce concurrent workers 6->4, 2) borrow temporary capacity in us-central, or 3) postpone test.
Aisha: filing fast reservation for +4 GPUs in us-central for the exact test window. infra-bot, file RES please.
infra-bot: Reservation created: RES-11888 | region=us-central | gpus=+4 | window=2026-03-29T18:00Z-21:00Z | priority=high. Approvers: @finance @allocs. ETA approval ~2h.
Rory: fallback if approval stalls: enable prefix/KV caching and drop batch_size 8->4 to keep p95 under 200ms.
Sofia: i'll run a quick eu->apac perf probe to quantify RDMA jitter; results in ~8m.
Ben: if RES-11888 approves, i'll open a tiny TF PR to bump pool count and point to vault creds. can someone paste a snippet?
Rory: quick snippet: ```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "temp_burst" {
  region    = "us-central1"
  gpu_count = 4
  labels    = { purpose = "temp-burst-test" }
}
```
Ben: perfect — i'll prepare PR with var override to 14 (current 10 + 4) once RES approved.
Aisha: vendor ops requested signed access window email to ops@vendor with contact. who can draft and get sec sign-off?
Sofia: i'll draft template and post in 10m. Ben, can you chase security for sign-off?
Ben: yes, i'll route to sec once Sofia posts.
VendorOps: we can accept remote flash if the bastion is reachable and the signed window email is provided. onsite option still available if needed.
infra-bot: Update: RES-11888 status=awaiting_approval. Approvers pinged.
Sofia: perf probe done 1 p95 added ~10ms during RDMA tune, jitter looks acceptable for a short borrow. logs attached to RES ticket.
Rory: ops checklist: if we change region for the canary, set DNS TTL to 30s 10m before cutover and prepare cert reissue.
Aisha: agree. i'm pinging @allocs and @finance directly. if approval doesn't land in 90m we will reduce workers and gate the end-to-end test.
Ben: standing by to PR. will tag here after merge.
Sofia: creating infra backlog item: vendor-firmware-visibility to avoid surprise handoffs next quarter.
Aisha: please add that and link it here. thanks all, will update when RES moves or vendor confirms access window.
